'''Madra''' was [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[City/Legends|city]] that was located in the [[Rym Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], near to a dormant [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]]. The city contained a number of underground [[Water/Legends|water]] pools that were renowned for their medicinal benefits.
